description: Catégories des routes is a dataset listed in Open data - Département d'Eure-et-Loir, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CD28. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - Catégories des routes Catégorie des routes départementales classées en C1, C2, C3 et C4: C1= Régionale et interdépartementale C2 = Départementale C3= Territoriale C4= Locale Attention, lors de la mise à jour du 10/02/2025 le schéma de données a été modifié.Les données sont ... Coverage: Eure-et-Loir. The portal files it under Routes. The portal shows 2,550 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-eurelien-fr-portal.
